validation.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email, for example name@company.com.
validation.invalidVat: VAT number should be 15 digits, starting and ending with 3.
validation.invalidIban: Enter a valid Saudi IBAN (SA followed by 22 digits).
validation.invalidPhone: Enter a Saudi mobile number, for example 0512345678.
validation.invalidContactPhone: Enter a phone number with digits only, for example 0138000000.
validation.invalidIqama: Iqama number should be 10 digits, starting with 2 (or 1 for a Saudi ID).
validation.invalidPassport: Passport number should be 5 to 20 letters and digits.
validation.invalidAmount: Enter an amount in SAR, for example 1500 or 1500.50.
validation.chooseSite: Choose an active site, or leave it empty.
validation.clientExists: A client with this name already exists.
validation.siteExists: This client already has a site with this name.
validation.iqamaTaken: A worker with this Iqama number already exists (check archived workers too).
validation.restoreClientFirst: Restore the client first, then the site.
validation.clientNotFound: No active client with this name. Add the client first, or check the spelling.
validation.siteNotFound: No active site with this name. Add the site first, or check the spelling.
validation.siteAmbiguous: More than one client has a site with this name. Fill in the Client column too.
validation.duplicateInFile: This appears more than once in the file.
validation.invalidQuantity: Enter a quantity above 0, for example 1, 26 or 7.5.
validation.tooManyLines: Too many items. Split them into two documents.
validation.dueBeforeIssue: This date must be on or after the document date.
validation.paymentTooLarge: This is more than the balance due. Check the amount.
validation.categoryExists: A category with this name already exists.
validation.refundTooLarge: This is more than the amount owed to the client.
validation.invalidDays: Enter the number of days, for example 2 or 0.5. It cannot be more than the days in the month.
validation.invalidHours: Enter hours, for example 10 or 7.5 (at most 300 in a month).
validation.netNegative: Deductions are more than the salary. Lower the advance or deductions (carry the rest to next month).
validation.timesheetWorkerUnknown: Worker not found. Keep the 'Worker ref' column from the template, or add the worker under Workforce first.
validation.timesheetWorkerAmbiguous: Two workers have this name. Use the template so each row has its worker ref.
validation.timesheetWorkerArchived: This worker is archived. Restore them under Workforce, or remove the row.
validation.timesheetWorkerTwice: This worker appears twice in the file. Keep one row.
validation.timesheetWorkerOnOtherSheet: This worker is already on another salary sheet for this month.

errors.timesheetWorkerOnOtherSheet: Some workers are already on another salary sheet for this month. Check the file again.

payroll.title: Salaries
payroll.subtitle: Monthly salary sheets from your timesheet, with payslips.
payroll.searchPlaceholder: Search worker name, Iqama last 4 or site
payroll.noResults: No salary sheet matches these filters.
payroll.emptyBody: Download the timesheet for a month, fill in absences and overtime, and upload it. The salaries are calculated for you.

wizard.subtitle: Three steps: download the timesheet, fill it in, upload it. You will see every salary before anything is saved.
wizard.step1Help: Choose the month. The file already lists your active workers; choose a site to get only its workers.
wizard.replaceHelp: The file lists the workers of {sheet} with what is already entered. Uploading it replaces the workers on this draft.
wizard.step2Help: Fill in the blue columns: absences, overtime, bonus, advances and deductions. Empty means 0.
wizard.summary: {valid, plural, one {# worker is ready} other {# workers are ready}}. {errors, plural, =0 {No errors.} one {# row has errors and will be skipped.} other {# rows have errors and will be skipped.}}
wizard.fixHint: Fix the red cells in Excel and upload again, or continue with the ready rows and add the others on the next page.
wizard.create: {count, plural, one {Create salary sheet with # worker} other {Create salary sheet with # workers}}
wizard.replace: {count, plural, one {Replace with # worker} other {Replace with # workers}}
wizard.noExcelHelp: Start a sheet with all active workers for this month (and site) and type absences and overtime on the next page.

payroll.draftHelp: Open a worker to change absences, overtime, advances or deductions. Approving locks the sheet and adds the salaries to Finance as expenses, per site.
payroll.draftReadOnly: This salary sheet is a draft. It can be changed again when your company is active.
payroll.refreshHelp: Changed a salary, allowance or site under Workforce, or the payroll rules? "Update salaries from Workforce" takes the new values and keeps what you entered here.

approve.explain: Total net pay {total}. After approval the sheet is locked and this amount is added to Finance as "Salaries" expenses on the salary date, one per site. You mark workers as paid on the next step.

payroll.approvedInfo: Approved {date}. The net pay is recorded in Finance as Salaries expenses, per site.
payroll.noWorkerMatch: No worker on this sheet matches.
payroll.noLines: No workers on this sheet yet. Use "Add missing workers" or upload the timesheet.
payroll.removeLineConfirm: Remove this worker from the salary sheet?
payroll.deleteDraftConfirm: Delete this draft salary sheet? Nothing was recorded in Finance yet.
payroll.reopenConfirm: Reopen? Its expenses are taken out of Finance until you approve it again.
payroll.reopenHelp: Found a mistake? The owner can reopen the sheet. Its expenses are removed from Finance until it is approved again.
payroll.rulesText: Daily rate = monthly amount ÷ {days} days. Unpaid absent days are deducted from the {absenceBase}. Overtime per hour = hourly {otBase} + {premium}% of hourly basic salary, with {hours} working hours a day. Net = salary − absence + overtime + additions − advances − deductions.

done.imported: {count, plural, one {Salary sheet ready with # worker.} other {Salary sheet ready with # workers.}} {skipped, plural, =0 {} one {# row with errors was skipped: use "Add missing workers" or upload again.} other {# rows with errors were skipped: use "Add missing workers" or upload again.}}
done.created: Salary sheet created with all active workers. Enter absences and overtime where needed, then approve.
done.reopened: Reopened. Its expenses were taken out of Finance. Approve it again when it is right.
done.refreshed: Salaries updated from Workforce and the payroll rules.
done.added: {count, plural, =0 {No missing workers: everyone active is already on a sheet this month.} one {# worker added.} other {# workers added.}}
done.paid: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing changed: already marked as paid.} one {# worker marked as paid.} other {# workers marked as paid.}}

settings.title: Payroll rules
settings.subtitle: How absences and overtime are turned into money. Used for every new salary sheet.
settings.legal: These are starting values, not legal advice. Check them against the Saudi Labor Law (overtime: Article 107) and your workers' contracts, for example with your accountant or on hrsd.gov.sa, before you pay salaries.
settings.defaults: You are using the default rules. Save to confirm them for your company.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can change the payroll rules.
settings.monthDays: Days in a month (for the daily rate)
settings.overtimePremium: Extra per overtime hour (% of hourly basic)
settings.overtimeFormula: Overtime pay per hour = hourly wage + this percent of the hourly basic salary. Example with the defaults: hourly full salary + 50% of hourly basic.
settings.absenceBase: Unpaid absent days are deducted from
settings.saved: Payroll rules saved. New salary sheets use them; open drafts use them after "Update salaries from Workforce".
settings.appliesTo: Approved salary sheets keep the rules they were made with.

payroll.reopenPaidHelp: Some workers are marked as paid. Undo the paid marks first if you need to reopen this sheet.

payment.title: Paying the workers
payment.undoAllConfirm: Mark every worker on this sheet as unpaid again?
payment.help: Mark workers as paid when they get their money (cash or bank). Unpaid salaries show on the dashboard. The payslip shows the paid date.
